biography: With over 25 years of experience in development and construction, I am a Professional Engineer and a real estate expert who leads the development team at CloudHQ, a leading provider of data center solutions. I am responsible for overseeing the entire development lifecycle of our projects, from entitlements and design to permitting and construction, ensuring quality, efficiency, and compliance. I have successfully delivered multiple large-scale data center projects across the US, exceeding client expectations and industry standards. I have also contributed to the growth and expansion of CloudHQ, securing new opportunities and partnerships, and enhancing our reputation and market position. I am passionate about creating innovative and sustainable data center solutions that meet the evolving needs of our clients and the society. I value collaboration, integrity, and excellence, and I strive to empower and support my team and our stakeholders.
